units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:1:6">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵇ</cite> top <he>שלא תָבוּר א״י</he> in order that Palestine should not lie waste.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>יובירו ואל וכ׳</he>; (read as) <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:9:7">Y. Ab. Zar. I, end, 40ᵇ</cite> <he>יָבוּרוּ</he> let them rather lie waste than rent them to a gentile.—Part. <cite ref="B01153"><he>בָּר</he></cite>, <cite ref="B01191"><he>בָּרָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B00354"><he>בּוֹרָה</he></cite>.

B. Mets. 101ᵃ שתהא ברה בידו in order that the field may rather lie waste in his own possession; cmp. Y. l. c. [Rashi fr. ברר to be clear and firm in his possession, by buying it back from the gentile. R. Ḥan., in Tosaf. a. l., בּוֹרָה, lying waste in the gentile’s possession; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90.] B. Bath. 168ᵃ לא צריכא [דאפי׳] בבורה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it means to say that even in the case of an unbroken field being rented, the tenant has to pay the scribe’s fees; Rashi: even if the field will have to lie fallow for some time to come yet. [Cmp. part. fem. חוֹלָה fr. חוּל.]

senses.gloss: a. הוֹבִיר (fr. יבר, or אבר) to let lie waste; to neglect.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:1">Arakh. IX, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 29b">29ᵇ</cite>) <he>הֵבִירָהּ</he> (<he>הוֹ׳</he>) if he let it untilled.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:3">B. Mets. IX, 3</cite> <he>הו׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>הב׳</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:11">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>מֵבִירָן</he> (<he>מוֹבִירָן</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6:1">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>מְבַיְּירָן</he> Pi.).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="B00327">same</cite>. Koh. R. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 32">Ex. R. s. 32</cite> (play on <cite ref="U01103"><he>שית</he></cite> in <he>אשיתך</he> <cite ref="Jeremiah 3:19">Jer. III, 19</cite>) <he>בִּיַּירְתֶּם עצמיכם</he> ye neglected yourselves (mentally).

senses.gloss: (denom. of בּוֹר II or בִּיר) to prepare a pitfall, to entrap.
